implementation_evidence: Versioned company-scoped alloy master requires source reference and independent quality/owner approval; no manufacturing limits are seeded.
Database computes pass/fail, refuses impossible totals and incomplete/unknown elements, pins the approved revision and binds request id to payload.

Approved chemistry is immutable; the current approved independently signed passing chemistry and a formally released heat are both required before further in-house billet allocation/issue/consumption.
Browser hints and measured-result forms read the same approved master; Wikipedia constants and manual pass picker removed.

Native tests exercise actual heat-release and billet-use triggers: unreleased heat refused, approved released heat permitted, latest failed retest refused; source/provenance/geometry/immutable guards remain active.
blockers: Omalco quality must enter and independently sign authoritative alloy specifications; recording/release deliberately fails closed until then.
Full downstream recall/containment for already-produced or dispatched material remains FS-11 scope.

acceptance_checklist: Versioned alloy specification master requires approval and provenance; no invented seeded limits.

Positive/negative boundary, role, cross-company, immutability and approval tests execute against replayed SQL.

items.title: A real key from production job to order line
implementation_evidence: Company/order/profile/source-line composite keys and a trusted production_job_lines projection preserve the existing single-line job contract and exact split planning.
The existing commitment guard continues to own remaining-quantity arithmetic. Unchanged historical source links do not block scheduling/notes; new identity or quantity changes require a valid source.

items.title: Join invoice lines to packed lines
implementation_evidence: Stored generated packed-line/dispatch keys derive from the canonical goods source IDs. Real composite company/dispatch/packed-row and invoice/dispatch foreign keys preserve charge lines and reject mismatches.
Existing database packing parity, exact-once coverage, one-active-invoice and immutable packing triggers enforce quantity/rate/bundle coverage; these rules are reused rather than duplicated.
Invoice detail shows packed-source links and explicit historical/error states. A paginated health RPC reports unresolved old links; clean history validates without firing historical invoice updates.
Canonical creation proves 25 kg x INR 300 = INR 7,500, exact generated keys, overbilling refusal and protected packed history.

items.title: Join weighbridge sessions to dispatches and purchases
implementation_evidence: Current sessions already have real dispatch/receipt keys. A new read model derives current vehicle-load evidence through those keys; manual readings require independent manager approval bound to the exact readings, quantities, calibration and vehicle hash.
Finalized readings/evidence are immutable and stale approvals cannot finalize changed evidence. Dispatch detail mounts the approval workflow and a purchase-receipt evidence route is available.
Vehicle-load net includes packaging and is not written over the separately measured packed metal or partial receipt quantities.
blockers: Complete purchase UI entry links, scrap-sale integration and the approved document-weight basis/manual fallback contract. Physical device and hosted acceptance are not performed.

items.title: Turn the important soft references into real keys
implementation_evidence: Fifteen concrete references become company-scoped composite RESTRICT foreign keys, initially NOT VALID then validated only where no orphan exists.
Owner/admin data-health report shows live orphan counts/examples and constraint validation; existing orphan rows remain unchanged.
Reuses equivalent parent unique/child indexes and refuses new ambiguous maintenance links without freezing unrelated historical expense updates.
blockers: expense_ledger.maintenance_record_id has no canonical parent table in this schema; domain mapping is required before a valid FK/backfill.
Any hosted orphans require reviewed reconciliation, then constraint validation; no records are deleted or silently nulled.
acceptance_checklist: Add real history-preserving keys for every explicit FS-116 soft reference that exists in this schema.
NOT VALID expand step preserves historical rows, orphan report exposes unresolved references, validation only succeeds on clean data.
New invalid/cross-company references are refused; no silent deletion/nulling.

items.title: A registry for type-and-id links
implementation_evidence: A sealed entity_types table and shared TypeScript registry cover 17 core types with canonical aliases, labels and safe local routes. Tasks/notifications normalize registered aliases and validate same-company, non-deleted source existence at transaction end, preserving BEFORE-source notifications.

Notification links reuse the helper while retaining current authorization/source revalidation. An owner/admin paginated review reports valid, missing and unregistered links without mutating historical evidence. SQL and TypeScript entries are compared by executable tests.
Registered purchased billet lots, lab requests and weighing sessions using existing routes. The established deferred source check now covers those types on tasks and notifications.
blockers: Other legacy record types, polymorphic consumers and verified source navigation remain.

implementation_evidence: Command Center no longer sums 13 tables: every KPI figure (booked revenue this and last month, receivables, collections, shipped kg, completed kg, scrap kg, recovery with captured/missing jobs, quote win rate) comes from public.fs_kpi.

items.title: Pull stray arithmetic back into the calculation library
implementation_evidence: Shared half-up rounding matches positive/negative PostgreSQL NUMERIC ties; a finite-aware display formatter replaces 180 UI rounding/formatting expressions without rewriting surrounding dirty source.
Expense and complementary blend arithmetic move into the calculation library. ESLint blocks new Math.round/toFixed in app/components and verifies mutation-boundary detection separately.
Independent arithmetic verifies 12.5 x 245.2 = 3,065; adding 551.70 tax and 100 freight less 16.70 discount totals 3,700.
blockers: A complete review/extraction of remaining inline GST, recovery and KPI arithmetic and consolidation of every monetary formatter remain. Existing expense zero-as-auto sentinel is preserved and needs an explicit amount-basis contract.
